# emaze

> > emaze is a cloud-based presentation and content creation platform offering digital photo albums, automated booking solutions (Automaze), and collaborative tools that serve as an alternative to PowerPoint and Prezi.

emaze provides a suite of digital content creation tools including presentation software, photo album builders, and group collaboration features with a Custom Dashboard and Digital Asset Manager. The platform serves education, automotive, events, and business sectors with both free and premium features.

## Key Topics

- emaze presentation software
- Automaze booking automation
- Digital photo albums and scrapbooking
- PowerPoint and Prezi alternative
- Groups and Custom Dashboard
- Digital Asset Manager
- EDU Account for education
- Presentation design and tips
- Content creation and collaboration tools
- Website traffic and engagement
- Visual superiority effect
- Memory preservation
- Event and venue management
- Public speaking techniques
- Automotive industry solutions

## Core Products & Features

- [Create a Personalized Digital Photo Album](https://www.emaze.com/photo-albums): Digital photo album creation tool with collaboration and sharing features
- [Automaze for Events and Venues | Simplify Bookings](https://www.emaze.com/bookings-done-right-with-automaze-for-events-and-venues): Automaze booking automation solution for events and venue management
- [Access Shared Group Content on Your Custom Dashboard](https://www.emaze.com/groups-custom-dashboard): Groups feature with custom dashboard for shared content collaboration
- [Automotive](https://www.emaze.com/automotive): Automotive industry solutions for sales, marketing, and customer success
- [Better than PowerPoint and Prezi - emaze is THE Alternative](https://www.emaze.com/better-than-powerpoint-and-prezi): Comparison showing emaze advantages over PowerPoint and Prezi
